description: This file contains integration tests for the storage component of a workflow management system, focusing on unit of work patterns, atomic workflow and execution storage, and status updates.

methods.name: setupTestDB
methods.description: Initializes a temporary in-memory database and returns a storage instance along with a cleanup function.

methods.name: TestUnitOfWork_BasicOperations
methods.description: Tests creation, state changes, and commit of a unit of work.

methods.name: TestWorkflowUnitOfWork_AtomicWorkflowExecution
methods.description: Verifies atomic storage of workflow and execution data within a unit of work.

methods.name: TestWorkflowUnitOfWork_RollbackOnError
methods.description: Ensures rollback occurs when an invalid operation is performed during a unit of work commit.

methods.name: TestWorkflowUnitOfWork_UpdateWorkflowStatus
methods.description: Checks that workflow status and associated execution data are correctly updated and stored atomically.

methods.name: ptrString
methods.description: Helper function to create a string pointer.

methods.name: ptrTime
methods.description: Helper function to create a time pointer.

methods.name: ptrInt64
methods.description: Helper function to create an int64 pointer.
